headlines.snippet: A prison officer was arrested on suspicion of assisting the investigation into the murder of Binyamin Razi by interfering with it through the brother of the main suspect. She is suspected of helping him escape while the police were searching for him. Her arrest came after a covert investigation initiated due to intelligence information received by the Prison Service.
